response.sql: WITH matched_fees_orders AS (SELECT f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate, o.mktnote FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), overall_avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS overall_avg_rate FROM matched_fees_orders), pair_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(mfo.mktnote, '') AS trading_pair, AVG(mfo.net_fee_rate) AS pair_avg_rate FROM matched_fees_orders mfo GROUP BY COALESCE(mfo.mktnote, '')), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT ps.pair_avg_rate, ps.pair_avg_rate - oac.overall_avg_rate AS excess FROM pair_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oac WHERE oac.overall_avg_rate IS NOT NULL AND ps.pair_avg_rate > oac.overall_avg_rate) SELECT AVG(pair_avg_rate) AS mean_of_pair_averages, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess FROM filtered_pairs
